Landed: cc-transcript #56 (14.42.0, the reuse key) and #57 (14.43.0, the core's own build identity bound into reuse compatibility); captain-hook #362 (12.93.6, reuse on with a file-hash identity, the unsound one), #364 (12.94.0, reuse off unless CAPT_HOOK_PREPARED_FACT_REUSE=1), and #366 (merged d7a8928: pin 14.43.0, file hash removed, reuse on again unless the variable is 0). Not yet true: no host runs any of this. The dev host still serves 12.93.5 and the coordinator owns installation; the release that carries d7a8928 was still building when this was written. Also open and parked: yasyf/homebrew-tap#4, a bounded retry of `stapler` exit 68 in the shared signing action, after three Captain Hook release attempts lost the connection to Apple's ticket endpoint.
